$comment: NOT a schema — this is DATA, asserted by a conformance case. SC-270 section 4. Every identifier listed here MUST exist in every supported Minecraft protocol version. Choosing a carrier that a downgrade target lacks recreates exactly the ViaVersion problem the wire protocol exists to avoid, so this list is deliberately conservative: it contains only content present since 1.21 and still present in 26.2. Adding a Minecraft node requires re-asserting it (SC-220 section 6 step 5).

blocks.$comment: Grouped by the visual and physical role a custom block might need. Selection is by material_instances colour, map_color, light and collision (SC-270 section 4).

items.$comment: The SERVER-side carrier is always lepus:item (SC-120 section 4). These are the WIRE carriers only, chosen for plausible stack size and category on a client that never applies the overlay.

entities.$comment: Chosen for size and class so that a client without the overlay sees something of roughly the right shape in roughly the right place.

forbidden.$comment: Never usable as carriers, with the reason. This list is as important as the allowed one.
forbidden.minecraft:bed: removed from item model definition specials in 26.2
forbidden.minecraft:standing_sign: removed from item model definition specials in 26.2
forbidden.minecraft:hanging_sign: removed from item model definition specials in 26.2
forbidden.minecraft:copper_golem_statue: added after 1.21; absent on older downgrade targets
forbidden.minecraft:end_cube: added after 1.21; absent on older downgrade targets
